summary: P0 hotfix validated. Created dedicated pytest suite (7 tests, ALL PASSING) that proves GET /api/libreta/{student_id} now mirrors the same `final_grade_manual > final_grade > on-the-fly recompute` precedence used by GET /api/grades/consolidated-report. Bug reported by edunet.pe (Señor de Gualamita): teacher-typed grades from the 'Manual de Notas' portal were persisted in student_grades.final_grade_manual but the libreta read ONLY `final_grade`, so cells displayed '-' while the Consolidado showed the values correctly. Fix in routes/libreta.py (lines 410-432) is correct and ready for deploy.
action_items: Safe to deploy the 4-line fix in /app/backend/routes/libreta.py to production (edunet.pe / Señor de Gualamita).
Optional: after deploy, run the new suite again in prod-like environment as a smoke test.
critical_code_review_comments: Precedence implementation in routes/libreta.py is now byte-identical in spirit to routes/grades.py — same order, same on-the-fly recompute guard against custom templates with grades_dynamic. Good consolidation.

Display rounding differs intentionally between endpoints: consolidado rounds to int (line 1011, routes/grades.py) while libreta returns the raw float. This is by design (libreta needs decimals for promedios). Tests assert parity at the displayed-integer level.

Suggestion (non-blocking): extract the 4-line precedence block into a shared helper (e.g. services/grades_resolver.py: resolve_final_grade(row, template)) so future endpoints don't drift again. Same bug class is recurring.

seed_data_creation: Test seeds 3 controlled rows in `student_grades` via direct Mongo writes (motor) with marker `_test_mark=TEST_LIBRETA_FGM_HOTFIX`. The fixture restores the original docs (or deletes the inserts) in teardown. Verified post-run that 0 leftover rows remain.

It picks any El Roble (subdomain=elroble) section with ≥3 active subjects + an enrolled student whose active-period libreta has no snapshot. Seeds 3 scenarios on student_grades, hits both endpoints, asserts the values and parity, then restores. Safe to re-run anytime — idempotent.

rca of the issue: GET /api/libreta/{student_id} (routes/libreta.py) was reading only `final_grade` from the `student_grades` collection. Meanwhile teachers using the 'Manual de Notas' portal (routes/teacher_portal.py) persist their override in `final_grade_manual` and leave `final_grade=None`. The Consolidado (routes/grades.py line 952-969) had already implemented the correct precedence (final_grade_manual > final_grade > on-the-fly recompute) — the libreta had not. Result: same student/bimestre, consolidated showed grades, libreta showed '-'. Fix applied: replicate the same precedence block in routes/libreta.py lines 410-432. Validated with 7 pytest cases including parity assertion against the consolidated endpoint.
